description: The `impai-handicap` test group's armed kbots, applied with impai-handicap-economy.json to impai-handicap.json, keeping every unit already there: two CORE AK for seat 1 (OTA AI) and two for seat 2 (ImpAI), each pair far from where the stock AI sends it, so each computer seat orders something every 300 ticks and moves something in the takeover's window whatever its economy does. The group assignment 0x408830 (every 30 AI ticks) puts an armed mobile unit in group 3, so both kbots are there by GameTime 330. The attack planner 0x4077E0, due every 300 ticks (0x4077F7), moves the first unit of group 3 into an empty group 2 (the rebalance 0x407560) and, with one to three units there, orders group 2 to move (mode 2, the group order 0x480460) to home (0x407869..0x4078C8): the mean position 0x407410 of the seat's armed structures, else of its other structures, else of its builders. So by GameTime 630 one kbot of each seat has been ordered home, and home is a mean of structures, each either one of the seat's economy structures or one its commander built: at least 1400 wu from these kbots, the economy structures by placement and the commander's by its reach, 1.07 wu a tick (CORCOM's maxvelocity) from a start over 3000 wu away. The test group takes over at GameTime 391, 91 ticks after the kbots appear: an order before 391 has moved a kbot at most 91 x 1.72 = 157 wu (CORAK's maxvelocity) of its 1400, and one after it moves the kbot from where it stood at 391, so each seat's ordered kbot moves more than 8 wu in the window [391, 2191): two of the computer seats' six mobile units at 391 (MEASURED: their commanders and these four), where the check asks a quarter. Seat 1's pair stands in a dry, flat box round (5324, 1708) and seat 2's round (4321, 6760) (heights 80 to 85 against the sea's 75, from the map's attribute grid), over 1300 wu from every other seat's unit. MEASURED 2026-11-12, played live: both pairs stood until GameTime 600 and had moved 450 to 700 wu by 900, seat 1's south-east round the water between it and home.
